evidence.summary: The post-migration source still receives MNP216 because process_run accepts one ProcessRequest only.
ProcessResult returns synchronously; it contains no aggregate cgroup envelope, raw cgroup result counters, or in-flight cancellation handle.
Forge's generic Runner boundary terminates an owned process group after native stale-work policy requests cancellation; this does not resolve process_run's source-visible effect gap.

metadata.pressure_boundary: synchronous process_run still lacks aggregate resource envelope and in-flight cancellation handle

reproduction.instructions: Compile src/mncs_forge/resources/pressure-reproducers/process-resource-handle.mncs against mncs-language ff5e98c and the Forge native library; process_run(request, envelope) returns MNP216.

summary: After native resource budget/admission/outcome/pending migration, the same minimal process resource-handle reproducer still fails at the generic effect boundary.
